subject: Contagion
advisory: Burn dose sizes, tells lead, Coalescence stage timings and the mutation deck weights are tuning; scenes check sign and order, never the number

leaves.oracle_proposed: weather is an RM_Contagion Bloom def and a judge reading the midday shot names it red and storm-roofed; control shot under vanilla rain is named grey
leaves.tier_reason: sky, weather, pawn health, jobs and things are runtime state of a running Contagion map; the offline selftest proves only the pure rules
leaves.experience: The player at play zoom on a Contagion map under the standing Bloom sees a red, storm-roofed sky and red rain or fog, never an ordinary grey overcast day.
leaves.scenario: Saved Contagion site v3, standing Bloom, midday, screenshots at play zoom; the same site retiled to a temperate forest under vanilla rain as the control.
false_pass: the weather def reads RM_ContagionBloom while the screen shows vanilla grey rain
a screenshot taken at night where every sky looks dark
leaves.red: a build whose Bloom weather loads with the vanilla rain sky colours, so the lid is not red
leaves.owner_part: yes: one midday shot of the standing Bloom beside the vanilla-rain control

leaves.oracle_proposed: first tell render tick precedes the Burn condition start by at least the configured tells window; with tells disabled in settings no tell renders and the Burn still comes
leaves.tier_reason: sky, weather, pawn health, jobs and things are runtime state of a running Contagion map; the offline selftest proves only the pure rules
leaves.experience: The player watching a Contagion map sees the tells first, gawpsacks sinking, rattlegrope shaking, red puffs and the rustle sound, and only then the light changing as the Burn arrives, never the Burn first.
leaves.scenario: Saved site, a natural Burn scheduled by clock jump to just inside the tells window; read tell renders and the Burn condition tick by tick across the window.
false_pass: tells fire on the same tick as the Burn so there is no lead
the tell state flag is set but nothing moves on screen
leaves.red: a build where the tells window is zero or the tell renderer never runs, so the Burn lands unannounced
leaves.owner_part: yes: a short capture of one tells window ending in the Burn

leaves.oracle_proposed: the near pair is in shade at Burn start; the far pair is not, and nothing moved them but their own jobs or the player's order
leaves.tier_reason: sky, weather, pawn health, jobs and things are runtime state of a running Contagion map; the offline selftest proves only the pure rules
leaves.experience: The player sees colonists within one dash of a planned refuge get inside during the tells lead, while a distant work party is caught in the open and must improvise.
leaves.scenario: Saved site, two colonists working 8 cells from a roofed refuge and two 60 cells away; a natural Burn tells window opens; read positions when the Burn starts.
false_pass: the near workers were already standing under the roof when the window opened
the Burn starts before any tell, so the lead was never offered
leaves.red: a build where colonists ignore the tells and keep working outdoors until burned, or where every pawn on the map is teleported to safety

leaves.oracle_proposed: dash colonist alive with a Burn dose above zero and below the downed threshold; the standing colonist's dose is at least three times the dasher's
leaves.tier_reason: sky, weather, pawn health, jobs and things are runtime state of a running Contagion map; the offline selftest proves only the pure rules
leaves.experience: The player orders a prepared colonist across open ground from one refuge to the next during a Burn and sees them arrive alive, hurt by a readable Burn dose, while a colonist left working outdoors for the whole Burn is gravely hurt.
leaves.scenario: Saved site during a forced Burn: a colonist crosses 20 open cells between two roofed refuges; a second colonist is drafted standing in the open for the Burn's length; read RM_BurnDose and health.
false_pass: the dash is safe because the Burn deals nothing to colonists
the dash colonist dies, so the Burn is a lockdown
leaves.red: a build where the Burn is either harmless to colonists or lethal within one crossing, so the dash is no choice: the lockdown he would stop the review on
leaves.owner_part: yes: the dash and its cost, the flagship stop line

leaves.oracle_proposed: dose rises exactly on cells the shade grid reads open and stays zero on cells it reads shade, across all five placements
leaves.tier_reason: sky, weather, pawn health, jobs and things are runtime state of a running Contagion map; the offline selftest proves only the pure rules
leaves.experience: The player sees a pawn take shelter from the Burn under a roof, under a tree's cast shade or in water, the same cells the shared shade overlay calls shade, and sees no pawn safe in a cell that shade calls open.
leaves.scenario: Saved site, forced Burn: pawns placed on a roofed cell, a cell in a tree's cast canopy shade off the trunk cell, a water cell, a trunk cell whose shade grid reads open, and plain open ground; read RM_MapComponent_ShadeGrid and Burn dose per pawn.
false_pass: only the trunk cell protects, as the old exact-cell tree test did
the scene places every pawn on a roof so geometry is never tested
leaves.red: a build that keeps the Burn's own exact-cell tree test beside the shared shade grid, so canopy shade beside a trunk still burns

leaves.oracle_proposed: the UV-shy native carries a Burn injury; Scaldhide and Crispling carry none; with the Burn ended none gains one
leaves.tier_reason: sky, weather, pawn health, jobs and things are runtime state of a running Contagion map; the offline selftest proves only the pure rules

false_pass: the UV-shy native was killed by a predator, not the Burn
every native is exempt so nothing is ever hurt
leaves.red: a build where Burn harm never reaches natives, the 2026-11-06 FAIL, or where armour exemptions are lost

leaves.oracle_proposed: at Burn start the UV-shy natives are sheltered with zero Burn dose and the sun lover is in the open; control with the dive setting off: they are hit in the open

false_pass: natives move only after they are already burned, the reactive dive that exists today
the dive is a teleport
leaves.red: a build where the only dive is the reactive sprint after damage, so the Burn hurts first and natives flee after

leaves.oracle_proposed: zero sun-escape jobs under the Bloom; at least one under the Burn with the same pawns
leaves.tier_reason: sky, weather, pawn health, jobs and things are runtime state of a running Contagion map; the offline selftest proves only the pure rules
leaves.experience: The player under the standing Bloom sees no Unfinished or native dashing for shade from the sun; once the Burn clears the sky the sun escape returns.
leaves.scenario: Saved site, standing Bloom at midday with Unfinished in the open; count sun-escape jobs over 2500 ticks; then force a Burn and count again.
false_pass: no Unfinished were on the map, so the count is zero for no reason

leaves.red: a build where the sun-escape trigger reads raw sun angle and ignores the weather's sunExposureFactor, so Unfinished dash under a covered sky

leaves.oracle_proposed: warning shown before warmup names the whole map; RM_ContagionBurn condition after warmup; condition gone within its hold time after power off; off-biome it is RM_RepulsorClearSky, never a Burn
leaves.tier_reason: sky, weather, pawn health, jobs and things are runtime state of a running Contagion map; the offline selftest proves only the pure rules
leaves.experience: The player switching on a Cloud Repulsor is told, before it starts, that its Burn covers the whole map and everyone in the open; once warm, the whole Contagion sky clears into the Burn, and the Burn lapses after its power is cut.
leaves.scenario: Saved site: build and power a Repulsor; read the warning text before warmup, the condition and weather after warmup, then cut power and read the lapse; the same on a temperate quicktest map, where it holds an ordinary clear sky.
false_pass: the warning appears only after the Burn has started
the Burn was a natural one that happened to start
leaves.red: a build where the Repulsor starts a map-wide Burn with no warning, or never lapses after power loss
leaves.owner_part: yes: the warning text and the sky clearing

leaves.oracle_proposed: the touched hediff is visible before the first mutation; exactly one transition message at the active-change stage; zero letters for sub-threshold exposure
leaves.tier_reason: sky, weather, pawn health, jobs and things are runtime state of a running Contagion map; the offline selftest proves only the pure rules
leaves.experience: The player sees a colonist who works out in the Bloom carry a readable early Contagion-touched health state and get one noticeable message when exposure turns into active change, never a letter for each small exposure.
leaves.scenario: Saved site, a colonist working outdoors under the Bloom for a day by clock; count letters and messages and read RM_ContagionTouched severity and stage across the day.
false_pass: the test sets the severity by hand
no letter fires because the colonist was indoors
leaves.red: a build where every exposure tick sends a letter, or where the change starts with no prior visible state

leaves.oracle_proposed: split within the data weights; no duplicate on one body; no body past the cap
leaves.experience: The player sees a touched colonist's changes come from a mixed deck, some harmful and some mixed blessings, capped and never repeated on one body.
leaves.scenario: Selftest over the mutation deck: 200 seeded draws per eligible body; read harmful versus mixed split, duplicates and the cap.
false_pass: the deck has only one card so the split is trivially met
duplicates are filtered by the test, not the deck
leaves.red: a build whose deck deals only harmful cards, or deals the same mutation twice, or ignores the cap

leaves.oracle_proposed: three buds with pairwise different rolled limb sites; the dead one leaves slime and RM mulch and no corpse
leaves.tier_reason: sky, weather, pawn health, jobs and things are runtime state of a running Contagion map; the offline selftest proves only the pure rules
leaves.experience: The player sees the Unfinished budded by a Bloody Mess each look differently half-made, and sees one that dies dissolve into slime and mulch, never an ordinary corpse.
leaves.scenario: Saved site, a Bloody Mess with its budding deadline jumped three times; screenshot each Unfinished at play zoom; kill one and read what it leaves.
false_pass: every Unfinished rolled the same limbs
the dead one left a corpse that was hauled away before the read
leaves.red: a build whose variation comp never rolls, or whose death leaves a corpse
leaves.owner_part: yes: the three Unfinished side by side

leaves.oracle_proposed: at least one stage up with absorption counted from arrivals; manhunters within the map cap; Burn collapse yields Monstrous samples and mulch, gunfire yields less mulch and no samples
leaves.tier_reason: sky, weather, pawn health, jobs and things are runtime state of a running Contagion map; the offline selftest proves only the pure rules

false_pass: the stage graphic is set by the test

leaves.oracle_proposed: stage 2 emits more manhunters than stage 1, still within the cap, all from the Coalescence; no unrelated incident fires

leaves.red: a build where a later stage adds no pressure, or adds pressure from outside the creature

leaves.oracle_proposed: odds visible in the existing UI before the job starts; batch of 2 to 4 donor-labelled parts; matched install gives the mood and no mismatch; the interrupted injection keeps the sample and starts no gestation

leaves.oracle_proposed: after reload the Burn clock, touched severity and gestation match the save; both orders give the same samples and letters; the repeated dash costs a dose again
leaves.tier_reason: the walk is the mod in play on the full list
leaves.experience: The player walks a lived-in Contagion colony through a Bloom day, a natural Burn with a dash, a Coalescence harvest and a gestation, and the sky and the body tell one story.
leaves.scenario: Load a lived-in Contagion save made mid-way through two in-game weeks; take a natural Burn with one dash, then harvest a Coalescence under a Repulsor Burn and start a gestation; reload and take them in the second order, harvest first; repeat the dash on the next Burn; read doses, hediffs, samples and letters each time.
false_pass: a fresh map stands in for the lived-in save
the second order is never run
leaves.red: a build where the Burn schedule, touched progression or gestation is lost on reload, or the order of harvest and Burn changes the outcome
